linkedin:
A system without a rhythm stops running the week the consultant leaves.

Step four of the TRACE method is C for Cadence: a sustainable rhythm that keeps the machine moving and turns hindsight into foresight.

Sustainable is the key word. A cadence your team burns out on is not a cadence. Humans included.

Target, Roadmap, Automation, Cadence, Enterprise. See the full method at tracestrategies.com.
